applicationMetaData.inventionTitle: Passive thermal compensation network for a bridge transducer
applicationMetaData.abstractText: A passive compensation network drives a piezoresistive bridge from a split excitation path and sums a dummy half-bridge tap into the bridge output, holding accuracy across an automotive temperature range without digital calibration.
An excitation supply for a resistive bridge uses a single ratio resistor to set the balance between a constant-current leg and a temperature-proportional leg.
